release_title: v1.4.0-alpha.34 — Adapter Replay Review Pack Triage Workbench
release_scope: Planning/control-plane milestone: v1.4.0-alpha.34 — Adapter Replay Review Pack Triage Workbench. Adds a no-network triage workbench for the adapter replay review pack: batch triage, queue filtering/sorting, inline trace preview, batch blockers, fixture-only review history, and export-ready triage summary. No live scraping. No production OAuth. No real OAuth. No real API keys. No credential persistence. No provider execution expansion. No backend behavior expansion. No storage expansion. No source behavior expansion. No automatic source verification. No automatic signoff. No automatic export lock. No cryptographic signing. No cryptographic signature claim. No publication permission claim. Preserves v1.3.0 — Stable Manual Workflow Release, v1.4.0-alpha.30 — Release Identity Single Source Contract, and v1.4.0-alpha.33 — Adapter Replay Review Pack Decision Queue. Preserves v1.4.0-alpha.7 — Source Acquisition Control Surface, v1.4.0-alpha.6 — Provider Execution Harness Mock-to-Live Equivalence, v1.3.0 — Stable Manual Workflow Release, and v1.4.0-alpha.14 — Adapter Replay Fixture Corpus + Coverage Matrix. Includes real API keys boundary and no cryptographic signing guarantees.
